release_notes:
Fix two bugs that could block customer logins by country

- Fixed: the "restrict login by country" feature used a free lookup
  service that was quietly shut down by its provider. Since then, any
  customer whose account had this restriction turned on could see
  "Your Country IP does not match with our records" and be unable to
  log in at all, regardless of where they actually were. The lookup
  now checks several sources in order and, if none of them can be
  reached, simply skips the restriction for that login instead of
  blocking the customer -- a lookup failure can no longer lock anyone
  out.
- Fixed: the "Apply Country IP Restriction At Client's Login" switch
  in Settings was wired backwards. Turning it on actually removed the
  restriction for every customer, and turning it off actually applied
  it to every customer -- the opposite of what the switch says. It now
  does what it says.
